description: This file is a shell script library for testing git-daemon functionality, providing utility functions for starting and stopping a git daemon, as well as for creating a simplified netcat client. It includes setup for environment prerequisites, managing daemon process lifecycle, and handling test conditions.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Starts a git daemon process with specified parameters, manages process ID, and ensures the daemon is running properly.

methods.name: stop_git_daemon
methods.description: Stops the running git daemon process gracefully, cleans up temporary files and process identifiers.

methods.name: fake_nc
methods.description: Imitates a netcat client to connect to a given host:port, sending stdin and printing the response.
